question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**breathed**" is the most suitable option as it correctly completes the phrase** "breathed his last", **which is a commonly used expression to indicate that someone has died.
 
• "**Exhaled**" also means to breathe out, but it is less commonly used in the context of someone dying.
 
• "**Panted**" means to breathe with short, quick breaths, typically after exertion or when in distress, and it does not fit the context of dying peacefully or naturally.
 
• "**Sigh**" is a noun, but we need a verb here to indicate the action of breathing one's last.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Mr. Reed had been dead for nine__ years: it was in this chamber he __breathed__ his last; here he (3) ________ in state; hence his coffin was (4) _________ by the undertaker's men; and, since that day, a (5) ___________ of dreary consecration had guarded it from frequent intrusion.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Exhaled (सांस छोड़ना)**: means breathed out, but less commonly used in this context.
 
• **Panted (हांफना)**: means to breathe with short, quick breaths, typically after exertion.
 
• **Sigh (निःश्वास)**: means to emit a long, deep, audible breath expressing sadness or relief, but it's a noun here.
